application_fee.details: The application fee of those not shortlisted will not be refunded. Incomplete applications or those whose fees is not paid will be summarily rejected.

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation Government of India Norms / Institute Employees Age relaxation will be as per norms of Government of India. Employees (including outsourced staff and employees working in Centres, Section-8 companies etc.) of the Institute will be eligible for age relaxation of up to five years or the serving period, whichever is less.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | assistant administrative officer (placement): Essential: Graduate in relevant domain with good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 8 years of relevant experience out of which 7 years at Pay Level-4. Or Equivalent experience for those working in private organizations. Or PG/Degree in Engineering with good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 7 years of relevant experience out of which 6 years at Pay Level-4 or equivalent experience for those working in private organizations.Desirable: 1. Post qualification work experience in educational/research institutes or MNCs. 2. Knowledge of computer applications. 3. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

salary_details.details: The position is associated with several benefits, including House Rent Allowance (HRA), Dearness Allowance (DA), Travel Allowance (TA), Medical Allowance, National Pension System (NPS), mobile expenses reimbursement, data card reimbursement, LTS reimbursement, Professional Development Allowance (PDA), Group Term Insurance, Group Health Insurance, Children’s Education Allowance, and NPL Bonus.

how_to_apply: Go to the official recruitment portal at Application Form.
Ensure your eligibility for the Assistant Administrative Officer post before filling out the online application form.
Fill in the required personal, educational, and professional experience details in the online application form.
Upload necessary documents if required and verify all entered details.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of INR 590 online (if applicable for your category).
Submit the application form on or before 15th October, 2026 by 5 PM.
Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application form and fee payment receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: All posts are contractual; initially for a period of five years or as recommended by the Selection Committee, extendable as per Institute norms and as per provisions of the Recruitment and Promotion Rules for Non-Teaching Staff – 2024. Prescribed qualifications are minimum and the mere fact that a candidate possesses the same will not entitle him/her to be called for the selection process. Shortlisted candidates will be informed for the selection process through e-mails mentioned in the application form only. A person working in Govt. Organization/ Autonomous Bodies/ PSUs, etc. will be required to produce the No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance (if applicable) through the proper channel. Internal candidates, while submitting an application for any post for Direct Recruitment, shall duly inform the HR division & Head of the Division. NoC will not be given at later stage, if there is no prior intimation and the candidature may be cancelled. Deserving candidate/s may be given higher starting salary/additional increments/pay protection. The appointment of reserved category candidate shall be on provisional basis and will be subject to verification of Caste/ Tribe / PwD certificate etc. For any queries related to the recruitment portal process, candidates can email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. What is IIITD Assistant Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIITD) under Advt. No. 34/2026 to fill 1 contractual vacancy for the post of Assistant Administrative Officer (Placement).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Administrative Officer post under the UR category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 15th October, 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in a relevant domain with a good academic record (minimum 55% marks) and total 8 years of relevant experience (7 years at Pay Level-4), or equivalent private sector experience. Alternatively, a PG/Degree in Engineering with 7 years of relevant experience (6 years at Pay Level-4) is accepted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms and Institute rules.
